03FIELD STORIES
FROM THE WARDENS
SALTMARSH
Holding the line on the Dartry de Guida pine die-back.

Three years on, the closed plots are sequestering at twice the lit-pasture rate. We log the curl-back of Phragmites across the channel.

04 MAY 2024 · 1,820 WORDS

BROADLEAF
Six fairways estuary returns: 1,072 ha in tidal exchange.

A tonal field report on the long-paused estuary reopening at Six Fairways. The first oystercatchers were on the inner reach within four tides.

18 AUG 2024 · 2,140 WORDS

PEAT HAG
Peat hydrology restored across the Lisheen headwaters.

Lateral runoff drains plugged at 142 chokepoints; water table now within 4 cm of surface for 124 of 180 days. The mire is sing-songing again.

22 NOV 2024 · 1,420 WORDS

05METHODOLOGY
READ TIME · 7 MIN
A1
Field measurement

Hectares are measured in two ways: by initial tenure, and by audited recovery against a forecast band agreed with a partner university before planting.

A2
Capital accounting

All deployed capital is recorded on a public ledger and double-entered. The foundry holds no off-ledger accounts; every account is signed-audit each February.

A3
Survival rates

Survival is reported at year-three, then at year-seven, then at year-fifteen. The intermediate years are noted but treated as transient.

A4
Community attribution

Where local people, including subsistence users, are working alongside the foundry, hours and craft are recorded — but never monetised in this report.
